postal_system.shape_rule: The main island uses five digits whose first digit identifies one of nine geographical districts; Rodrigues uses R plus four digits and Agalega uses A plus four digits. Shape alone is not assignment evidence.
postal_system.assignment_rule: Production assignment authority requires a digest-pinned current Mauritius Post result or an exact Open Data Mauritius territory row from the mainland, Rodrigues or Agalega partition with source version, observed_at, valid-time and field-level rights. A valid shape, UPU rollout article or post-office address is insufficient.
postal_system.territory_rule: Main-island, Rodrigues and Agalega code families remain explicit. A numeric district, statistical region, municipal ward, Village Council Area or Rodrigues local region must not be substituted for the postal territory or a current assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No reviewed Mauritius Post or Open Data Mauritius postcode artifact publishes canonical full-code boundary coordinates. Default full-code geometry is none; district, ward, VCA, locality, post-office point, buffer, Voronoi surface, model output and AGID cover are never an official postcode polygon.
postal_system.address_rule: The reviewed address form places the five-character postcode after the locality. Building, unit, house number, street and sub-locality remain separate components, and a P.O. Box or post-office identity does not establish a residential premise.
postal_system.open_data_rule: The mainland, Rodrigues and Agalega postcode tables are separate CC BY-SA 4.0 artifacts. Exact artifact digest, attribution, share-alike obligations, schema, date and territory coverage must be preserved; a row supplies assignment context but no boundary or building relation.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Statistics Mauritius states that the nine geographical districts are not administrative entities and that 2022 Municipal Ward and Village Council Area boundaries differ from 2011. Every crosswalk is versioned, time-scoped and non-postal.
postal_system.office_rule: Government open-data post-office addresses and points identify facilities only. A facility point or its postcode is not a delivery catchment, customer address, P.O. Box holder record, postal polygon or building assignment.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a rights-cleared civic address point, matching normalized components, an explicit address-to-building relation and independently licensed building geometry. Postcode, sub-locality, office point, census building count, cadastral parcel, nearest feature, containment and model score are insufficient.
postal_system.land_rule: The Cadastral Survey Act 2011 establishes a controlled digital cadastral database with parcel geometry, identifiers and street-address particulars, subject to access and confidentiality. It does not by itself prove a postcode polygon, public civic address, building relation, owner, resident or occupant.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Mauritius Data Protection Act 2017 controls personal and location data through lawful purpose, transparency, accuracy, security, retention and data-subject rights. Person-linked precise addresses, recipients, box holders, owners, residents, occupants and query histories are not public artifacts.
postal_system.realtime_rule: Live finder or CKAN API observations become bounded normalized receipts with source URL, terms version, artifact digest, observed_at, valid-time, territory and parser version; there is no invisible unverified live fallback or training mirror.
postal_system.model_rule: Learned models may rank candidates, detect drift, compress indexes or propose derived surfaces. They never confer official assignment, polygon, administrative identity, address, building or deliverability authority.
postal_system.compression_rule: A minimal perfect hash and Parquet, FlatGeobuf or PMTiles candidate layers are allowed only while exact five-character strings, leading letters, territory, validity, authority, lineage, uncertainty and correction paths remain recoverable.
postal_system.hosting_rule: Cloudflare and Hugging Face may host only digest-pinned, rights-cleared, CC BY-SA-compliant, minimized and non-personal public artifacts. Restricted cadastral, address or building evidence remains on controlled infrastructure.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID is an independent spatial index and versioned crosswalk. An AGID cell or cell union is not a Mauritius Post assignment or polygon, administrative boundary, cadastral parcel, civic address or building.

validation_rules.pass: Every promoted row has a current Mauritius Post or exact official open-data artifact, approved rights, digest, observation time, valid-time and explicit territory.
Every normalized code is five digits or A/R plus four digits; syntax never substitutes for assignment evidence.
Main island, Rodrigues and Agalega families and their artifact lineage remain explicit.
No code is published with canonical Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry without issuer-authorized boundary evidence.
Postal, administrative, statistical, office, cadastral, address, building and AGID authority are stored separately.
Explicit rights-cleared address-building relation and matching normalized components are present.
No personal, title-holder, subscriber, recipient, occupant or query data is published and every field has approved rights.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production gates.

stages.definition: Sources, semantics, licences and blockers inventoried.
Contract, source profile and synthetic conformance fixtures reviewable.
Rights-cleared observations reproduce a digest-pinned experimental pack.
Independent holdout, ambiguity, privacy, freshness and correction gates pass.
Two consecutive refreshes pass and rollback is monitored.
